Career Objective 
 
Data Scientist with 5 years of experience in retail lending, portfolio risk 
assessment, delinquency reduction, underwriting analytics, scorecard -based 
segmentation and credit decision optimisation across fintech and NBFCs. 
Skilled in analysing bureau data, repayment behaviour, FOIR, 
delinquency performance, roll rates, vintage curves , and developing 
risk mitigation strategies to improve portfolio quality. Strong domain 
knowledge across Personal Loans, Payments Bank customers, and 
digital lending. 
 
Proficient in SQL, Python, Power BI, Tableau , and experienced in  building 
automated risk reports, lender decks, fraud -risk modules, collection 
performance insights and campaign-risk strategies. 
 
Work Experience (5 Years) 
 
Mahindra Finance- Manager -Business Analytics (June 2024 - till date) 
Roles and Responsibilities 
● Developed and validated a Personal Loan Probability of Default (PD) model 
using logistic regression, incorporating bureau scores, FOIR, enquiry velocity, 
income stability, and past delinquency signals; performed feature selection, 
multicollinearity checks, temporal validation, and calibration and supporting 
risk-based underwriting, pricing, and portfolio monitoring. 
● Conducted monthly portfolio risk assessments , analysing delinquency,  roll 
rates, pool performance, and risk segment transitions. Delivered detailed 
insights used by the Risk & Credit teams for decisioning. 
● Managed credit-risk evaluation for targeted PL campaigns , ensuring no 
deterioration in risk profile while reducing marketing cost by ₹12 
lakh/month, generating ₹1.2 crore annual savings. 
● Utilised bureau scores, repayment behaviour, FOIR and delinquency patterns to 
launch risk -calibrated offers, resulting in 30% uptake among dormant 
customers and ₹4 crore incremental profit. 
● Improved approval rates by 25% for Airtel Payment Bank customers  
through customer-journey RCA, identifying risk-relevant drop-off points. 
● Conducted analytics on credit rejects, approved -not-taken (ANT) customers, 
and market competition to refine credit policy and risk pricing. 
● Created risk decks covering vintage curves, roll rates, risk segment 
migration, NPA trends, and collection performance. 
● Implemented a Voice Bot solution with vendors, reducing  costs and increasing 
qualified leads by 20%.
